how: Skydive Dubai runs tandem skydives and the AFF licence course from its Palm Dropzone at Dubai Marina and a Desert Campus dropzone.
iFLY indoor skydiving (vertical wind tunnel flying) operates inside Mirdif City Centre; this is simulated freefall rather than a real jump.
Aventura Parks in Mushrif Park offers colour-graded high-rope adventure circuits with ziplines, tight ropes and wobble bridges for all levels.
No public BASE jumping is offered; only one-off authorised and unauthorised jumps from Burj Khalifa by professional BASE jumpers have occurred.
Dubai's urban area is flat desert with no caves; the nearest are in the Hajar Mountains, such as the Jebel Hafeet cave system near Al Ain, roughly 150 km away (about 1.5-2 hours by road).
